status: measured implementation profile; NOT a conformance claim

implementation.runtime: Node >= 20; node:crypto only; zero third-party dependencies
implementation.hash: hashJson(v) = sha256Hex(canonicalize(v)), SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes of the canonical string
rules: arrays preserve order, joined by comma without spaces
objects require Object.prototype or null prototype; non-plain objects are rejected
object keys are sorted with Object.keys().sort() (UTF-16 code unit order)
string escaping follows JSON.stringify; non-ASCII is emitted as-is (UTF-8)

appendixB.note: NaN and Infinity correctly rejected; all 24 finite number samples match RFC 8785 Appendix B JSON Representation

rfc8785.conclusion: PriorSeal canonicalize matches RFC 8785 JCS on the 3.2.2 reference sample and all 26 Appendix B number vectors. V8 JSON.stringify uses the same ECMAScript number/string serialization that JCS requires.
notClaimed: No full I-JSON input-constraint validation (lone surrogates, duplicate keys, BOM) has been run
Extra restrictions beyond JCS (non-plain objects and unsafe keys) are stricter, not equivalent
No official full JCS conformance suite has been executed
Therefore: JCS-like deterministic canonicalization, verified on published vectors, NOT RFC 8785 conformant

rfc6962.local: merkle-log.mjs: merkleLeafHash = hashJson({domain,entryHash}); merkleParentHash = hashJson({domain,left,right}); complete power-of-two subtrees persisted for O(log n) proofs
differences: Hash input is canonical JSON, not raw byte concatenation
Tree shape is power-of-two decomposition, not the RFC 6962 split rule
rfc6962.conclusion: Functionally an append-only Merkle inclusion-proof log; NOT RFC 6962 wire-compatible

rfc3161.local: file-anchor-provider.mts: eip155 anchor(uint256 size, bytes32 head) transaction, independently re-verified over RPC (tx hash, receipt status, blockHash, block.timestamp, calldata decode, confirmations)
differences: External anchor is an on-chain transaction, not an RFC 3161 TSA token
rfc3161.conclusion: Equivalent external existence proof with a different carrier; NOT RFC 3161

rejectionCases: nonfinite -> TypeError: non-finite number is not valid canonical JSON
unsafe-key -> TypeError: unsafe canonical JSON key
non-plain-object -> TypeError: canonical JSON requires a plain object
undefined -> TypeError: undefined is not valid canonical JSON
verificationRecipe: Pin the issuer public key OUT OF BAND (bundled keys are discovery metadata, not a trust anchor)
Verify the Ed25519 signed checkpoint with verifyEd25519Statement (ed25519.mjs, node:crypto only)
Verify chain continuity and inclusion proof with verifyTransparencyEvidence / verifyMerkleProof
Independently re-verify the on-chain anchor over any RPC for that chain
No vendor server is required for steps 3-4
